$comment: Beckett's GitHub identity (#114). The 0xbeckett machine account is permanently lost (2FA
unrecoverable); Beckett is now a GitHub App owned by the kowo-co org, acting as beckett[bot].
This file is the source of truth for the app's registration. Register it with:
which POSTs this manifest to GitHub, catches the redirect, exchanges the temporary code, and
writes the private key + env lines out. See docs/github-app.md for the click-through.
Permissions are least-privilege for an agent that reads and writes code and PRs. Widening
them re-prompts every existing installation for approval, so add only what a task actually
needs, and edit BOTH this file and the live app settings so they never drift.
If the name "beckett" is taken at registration time, GitHub rejects the whole POST; change
`name` here to "0xbeckett" and re-run. App names are globally unique across GitHub.
name: beckett
description: Beckett — an agentic coworker reached in Discord. Install it on the repos you want it to work in; it opens branches and PRs as beckett[bot].
